data.name: Settings.AdminListPageSizeNote
data.value: Number of rows per page in the Users, Groups and Search folders lists.

data.name: Settings.Exclude.BuiltIn
data.value: The built-in defaults are in use (temporary files of macOS, Windows, Office, Vim, Emacs, NFS/Samba, and so on).

data.name: Settings.Exclude.Existing
data.value: Folders that are already registered are not affected.

data.name: Settings.Exclude.Help1
data.value: You can use {0} (any string) and {1} (a single character) in names. Matching is case-insensitive.

data.name: Settings.Exclude.Help2
data.value: Add {0} at the end to match folders only (example: {1}).

data.name: Settings.Exclude.Help3
data.value: Lines starting with {0} are treated as patterns too (for Emacs {1}), so comments cannot be written.

data.name: Settings.Exclude.Help4
data.value: Up to {0} patterns and {1} characters in total.

data.name: Settings.Exclude.Intro
data.value: These patterns are pre-filled in the exclude patterns field when you add a new search folder.

data.name: Settings.Exclude.ResetConfirm
data.value: This discards your edits and restores the built-in defaults. Continue?

data.name: Settings.Exclude.Saved
data.value: Saved. It will be applied to the field when you add new folders (registered folders are not changed).

data.name: Settings.ExcludeCard.Note
data.value: Set the patterns that are pre-filled in the exclude patterns field when you add a new search folder.

data.name: Settings.Kinds.Intro
data.value: Set the icon shown next to "Name" in search results and the extensions it applies to.

data.name: Settings.Kinds.Note1
data.value: Each extension can belong to only one type. Extensions are case-insensitive.

data.name: Settings.Kinds.Note2
data.value: Files that match no type use the "File" icon.

data.name: Settings.Kinds.Note3
data.value: For the icon you can use an emoji (on Windows, press Win + .) or 2 to 3 short characters.

data.name: Settings.Kinds.ResetConfirm
data.value: This discards all your edits and restores the standard settings. Continue?

data.name: Settings.Kinds.Row.ExtensionsPlaceholder
data.value: Example: txt, log, conf (separate with commas, spaces, or line breaks; no dots)

data.name: Settings.Kinds.Row.NoExtensions
data.value: Extensions cannot be specified (only the icon and name can be changed)

data.name: Settings.Kinds.Saved
data.value: Saved. It will be reflected in the icons in search results.

data.name: Settings.Kinds.Scope
data.value: What you save here applies to the search results of all users.

data.name: Settings.Kinds.Standard
data.value: The standard settings are in use.

data.name: Settings.KindsCard.Note
data.value: Set the icons shown next to names in search results and the extensions they apply to.

data.name: Settings.LogPageSizeNote
data.value: Number of entries per page in the operation log. This is set separately from the search result page size.

data.name: Settings.PageSizeNote
data.value: Used when a user has not set their own page size.

data.name: Settings.PolicyCard.Note
data.value: Set the minimum password length, password complexity and the number of failed sign-ins before lockout.

data.name: Settings.Policy.Note
data.value: Applies to all users. Password rules apply the next time a password is set or changed (existing passwords keep working).

data.name: Settings.Policy.ComplexityNote
data.value: Passwords must contain at least {0} of: uppercase, lowercase, digits and symbols.

data.name: Settings.Policy.MaxFailedNote
data.value: Between 0 and {0}. 0 disables lockout. A locked account is unlocked automatically after {1} minutes; administrators can unlock it at any time from the user edit page.

data.name: Settings.Policy.MaxAgeNote
data.value: Between 0 and {0} days. 0 means no expiration. After this many days users are asked to change their password on the next access. Counted from the day each user last set their password.

data.name: Settings.Policy.History
data.value: Number of passwords that cannot be reused

data.name: Settings.Policy.HistoryNote
data.value: Between 0 and {0}. 0 disables the check. A password cannot be changed to any of the most recent passwords, including the current one.

data.name: Settings.Incremental.Note
data.value: Updates the results automatically as you type, without pressing Enter. If searching is heavy on the server, turn it off or raise the minimum characters and the delay.

data.name: Settings.Incremental.MinCharsNote
data.value: Searching starts once at least this many characters are typed ({0} to {1}).

data.name: Settings.Incremental.DelayMsNote
data.value: Searching starts this long after the last keystroke ({0} to {1}).

data.name: Settings.AdCard.Note
data.value: Adds an "ActiveDirectory" tab to the sign-in page so that users can sign in with their domain username and password.

data.name: Settings.Ad.Note
data.value: Only users registered beforehand in User management can sign in with ActiveDirectory. Passwords are verified by ActiveDirectory and are never stored in NowFound.

data.name: Settings.Ad.ServerNote
data.value: Host name or IP address of the domain controller (e.g. dc01.corp.example.com).

data.name: Settings.Ad.SecurityNote
data.value: Without protection, passwords are sent in clear text, so use "None" only in a test environment. The server OS must trust the certificate.

data.name: Settings.Ad.DomainNote
data.value: Appended to the username to authenticate as "username@domain" (e.g. corp.example.com).

data.name: Settings.Ad.Lookup.Note
data.value: An account used by "Check that the user exists" on the Add user page to look the user up in ActiveDirectory. Specify a read-only account that can search the directory. It is not used for sign-in.

data.name: Settings.Ad.BindUserNote
data.value: A username (the domain is appended), user@corp.example.com, or a DN. Leave empty to disable the lookup.

data.name: Settings.Ad.BindPasswordNote
data.value: Stored encrypted and never shown. Saving with an empty lookup account also deletes the stored password.

data.name: Settings.Ad.SearchBaseNote
data.value: If empty, it is derived from the domain (corp.example.com becomes DC=corp,DC=example,DC=com). Specify it to limit the lookup to an OU.

data.name: Settings.Ad.Test.Error
data.value: The check could not be run. Try again.

data.name: Settings.TransferCard.Note
data.value: Export or import the search folders, the system settings and the file kinds as JSON files (for example, to move them from a test environment).

data.name: Transfer.Note
data.value: Use this to move settings between environments. It is not needed when you move the whole database (main.db). An import validates everything first and changes nothing if any item is invalid.

data.name: Transfer.Folders.Note
data.value: Covers the name, path, exclusions and share settings. A folder with the same path is updated and a new one is added (folders missing from the file are not deleted). Group assignments are not included.

data.name: Transfer.System.Note
data.value: Covers page sizes, incremental search, default exclude patterns, the account policy and the ActiveDirectory settings. The bind account password is not exported. After the import, set the bind account password again on the ActiveDirectory settings page.

data.name: Transfer.FoldersImported
data.value: Imported the search folders ({0} added, {1} updated).

data.name: Transfer.BindPasswordNeeded
data.value: The bind account password is not imported. Set it again on the ActiveDirectory settings page.

data.name: Transfer.FileKinds.Note
data.value: Covers the icons, names and extensions shown in the search results. An import replaces the whole setting (the current one is not kept).

data.name: Settings.Export.Note
data.value: Settings for downloading search results as CSV / TSV.

data.name: Settings.Export.AllowAllUsersNote
data.value: When off, only administrators can use it.

data.name: Settings.Export.MaxRowsNote
data.value: Rows beyond this number are not written ({0} to {1}).
